Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL3885882. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, filter by assay_id matching CHEMBL3885882, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
